about: Words said aloud during a take to direct the cut. Each is a word said twice in a row, so it does not turn up in ordinary speech. first-edit/launch listens for them, acts on them, and trims them out of the clips. Add a line to add a cue; 'heard_as' lists other ways the transcriber may write it.

cues.means: This scene is finished. Everything said since the last cut is one scene, and each try at it is a clip; the next thing said starts a new scene.
The clip just finished is the one to use for this scene.
